Results.ReviewText: Starts first time and cooked steaks perfect. Easy to assemble w clear instructions, well boxed.
Results.Title: Starts first time

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely worth it! It's very Compact, Well Made, & Convenient. Perfect for Patio's, Parks, Beaches, and more. Safe BBQ Unit. Great Colors to choose from also. Great Job Weber⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Results.Title: Perfect Portable Grill:

Results.ReviewText: A month ago I bought this little Webber Q1200 to replace an existing bulky BBQ.  I have a small deck and this Weber takes up little room.  It heats up fast and the cooking surface is sufficient for the 2 people in my household.  It would definitely cook for 4-5 people.  It heats up fast but will see how it does in colder winter weather.  The only downside I have found so far is when you open the lid, the temperature will drop so you cannot open it for long.  Other than that, I love this little BBQ.
Results.Title: Great compact BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Works just as good as my big grill. The right side handle is crowded by the gas bottle regulator, making it hard to hang on to.
Results.Title: Portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought a month ago and couldnt be happier. Just make sure your marinade doesnt have a lot of added sugar as cleanup was hell.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Great “portable” grill! The lid does rattle during transporting. Stuffed wads of newspaper under the lid to keep from rattling.
Results.Title: Noisy lid.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect helper in wilderness,good design. Easy to use.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Je suis très satisfait de mon Barbecue au gaz Weber.
Results.Title: Très bon produit

Results.ReviewText: Weber is an industry leader in the BBQ world. They have done it again, excellent heat management, great BBQ results. You won’t be disappointed.
Results.Title: Exceeded my expectations

Results.ReviewText:
Bought 1200 grill package in april at ace hardware. today the cover hold down strap broke. Got on warranty site and in 15 minutes, ebony had the right part on order and ready to ship with no problem.
Your warranty service is excellent!  Could not be happier with 1200 grill
keep up the great work!
Results.Title: replacement parts

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little grill - the only thing remains to be seen is performance over time.
Results.Title: Fire

Results.ReviewText: Bought from Johnstones BBQ in Surrey. They set it up to run on my onboard RV tanks. Worked great, right away.
Results.Title: easy set up, works great

Results.ReviewText: I had the larger weber previously and loved it. I needed to downsize for storage space in my trailer and it s works great
Results.Title: cooks great

Results.ReviewText: We like this small Weber gas grill.   It does a nice job grilling and their new ignition system is far better than the one on the old portable Weber that we owned.    We only rated it #4 because their are two small, but annoying problems.  The grill cover is terrible and barely covers the grill.   The Velcro strap that is supposed to hold down the top of he grill during transport is too short and cannot be fastened Velcro-to-Velcro.
Results.Title: Good small grill with some small problems.

Results.ReviewText: It’s awesome , I use it  twice a week and it cooks to perfection
Results.Title: I’m enjoying everything that I bbq on it

Results.ReviewText: This unit has great features, cooks evenly and has very good temperature regulation.  Fits perfectly in the pass though of our RV.
Results.Title: A great unit for the RV

Results.ReviewText: Grill should come with an optional quick disconnect feature for use on RV's.
Results.Title: Great Grill But.............

Results.ReviewText: For what we use it for it works great....it's small and perfect for us.  It does require a great deal of cleaning, which is not fun.
Results.Title: Great small grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this item for its size for in our motorhome.  Fits perfectly in the compartment.  First time used it and works great.  Just what we were looking for.
Results.Title: Works great

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We appreciate you taking the time to provide your feedback regarding your Q1200 grill. It is unfortunate to hear you had an issue threading in the 1lb tank. We do also have an adapter hose available. We have reached out via email to discuss this option further with you. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Couldn’t thread in any 1lb propane tanks from the moment I brought the grill home. Terrible engineering. Weber sent a new regulator to me but I’m at a temporary location with no tools or know how to change the regulator. So I just don’t use the brand new grill and will just throw it away when I leave this location. I wasted $219. A 40 year loyal customer is shocked.
Results.Title: The terrible situation with the Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: This orange Weber is not just super clean and cute . . . It cooks so evenly, and cooks super clean as well.  I am so over charcoal briquets. This is the way to BBQ!
Results.Title: Little Orange Weber is Awesome!

Results.ReviewText: It is a great grill for a small family or a small group of people.
Results.Title: The perfect grille.

Results.ReviewText: Gets hot fast. Even temps, adequate size cooking surface. Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Nice grill for the camper.

Results.ReviewText: This is my first gas grill. The grill design is very well thought out, well constructed and is easy to clean. Instructions are clear. It is light weight without the grates. The Q1200 is adequate for small groups if grilling is limited to a single course. It is compact enough for car camping and tailgates.
Results.Title: My first gas grill Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!  Easy start, heats up quickly. Even though this is the smaller version, it still has plenty of room for our cooking needs.
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill when I cook just for myself. Cooks great and cleanup is fast.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Seems to be well built.  My biggest disappointment is the control valve.  It gets way too hot on low which makes any direct heat grilling nearly impossible.  Every other gas grill I've owned has a better spread between low and high as far as flame height and temp control is concerned.  Not so much on the Q.  For the purchase price of the Q I expected better.
Results.Title: Needs better flame control from low to high.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this little BBQ when my Weber Summit was damaged to keep us grilling until my new Weber comes in and I must say, I am pleasantly surprised how great this little guy works!!
Results.Title: My Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this great product about two months ago for a family reunion... and I'm very pleased that I did. Overall, this gas grill performs very well... the push button igniter works like a charm and the cooking grates provide a really nice roomy surface for grilling all types of food. Finally, it's a really attractive product.
Results.Title: Great features and super overall design.

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Webber Q and we love it as much as we did our first one. It's perfect for the two of us. Easy to use and clean. And it can handle a family cookout with ease. And we always take it with us when we go on a road trip. Our first one was with us for over 7 years and I bet this one will be too/
Results.Title: We love our Webber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Every thing we have cooked has come out perfectly !
Results.Title: Lovemy grill !

Results.ReviewText: I have been a " Weber" charcoal guy for over 20 years.  Mater of fact, I gave a gas grill away.  Due to fire restrictions, charcoal is out.  I love BBQing and Grilling.  The Q 1200 has out preformed my expectations.  No down side thus far.
Results.Title: Weber does it again.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We hope that you get many great meals off of your grill. Thanks!
